description: AID orchestrator harness hooks — one entry point (scripts/aid-hook.sh), one registry (defaults/hook-registry.yaml). Both Claude Code and Codex read a plugin-root hooks/hooks.json in this shape, so the two tools are declared once. SessionStart carries NO matcher on purpose: which start sources a rule cares about is a registry decision (the handler reads .source), and the canary has to see every start or it cannot prove the layer runs.
